cat > /workspace/submission/README.md <<'MDEOF'
# CrossCheck replay package

Entry point: `python3 -B -u submission/main.py`. It reads one UTF-8 JSON request
from stdin until EOF, writes exactly one JSON answer to stdout and exits zero.
Strict JSON failures (duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, invalid UTF-8, empty
input, malformed text, BOM) answer `{"error":"invalid_json"}`. No files, threads,
child processes or sockets are used, so a request replays identically every time.

## Modules

| file | role |
| --- | --- |
| `crosscheck/strictjson.py` | strict parse/serialize boundary |
| `crosscheck/common_utils.py` | canonical flows, counter keys, routing plan, integer agreement band |
| `crosscheck/dtp.py` | capacity-bounded Democratic Trust Propagation repair |
| `crosscheck/snapshot_cache.py` | semantic-key LRU repair cache and frozen snapshots |
| `crosscheck/validate.py` | frozen-repair versus current-expectation checks |
| `crosscheck/crosscheck.py` | per-stream state machine for patch/routes/repair/validate |

## Replay policy highlights

* Prediction: internal flows floor `sum(demand * path_weight)/1000` once after all
  contributions; external flows use their exact demand marginal. A repair vote is
  clamped to the flow capacity while validation expectations stay unclamped, which
  keeps an excessive controller demand detectable.
* Baseline pool order is source report, destination report, clamped prediction.
  Equal values stay separate entries; an empty pool samples zero but never votes.
* Scenario `t` for router `r` picks `pool[W mod len(pool)]` with `W` the unsigned
  big-endian first eight SHA-256 bytes of `seed:r:t:a:b`; a flow already frozen
  supplies its frozen value instead.
* Router evidence is the conservation remainder of each trial (the target's own
  sampled value cancels), clamped to `[0, capacity]`, reduced by the agreement band
  `1000000*(hi-lo) <= epsilon*hi` with weight equal to the band mass.
* Publishing repeatedly fixes the remaining flow with greatest support, ties by
  smallest canonical pair, always measured with exactly the current frozen prefix.
  Confidence is `support/trials`, reduced.
* To stay linear in flow count, only the per-router conservation imbalance
  `D_r(t)` is maintained; freezing a flow can only change `D` at its own endpoints,
  and nothing at all changes when the frozen value already equals every sample.
* Memoization identity is topology, normalized measured inputs (missing included),
  demands, complete route contents or null, and seed/trials/epsilon. Labels, ignored
  annotations, input order, snapshot ids and validation settings are not identities;
  splitting or merging weighted path entries is. Cache entries, snapshots and answers
  never alias each other and snapshots survive eviction and input changes.
MDEOF
